scientific_integrity: All bounded integral torsion tests use exact integer Smith normal form and provide complete connected-case records. The nonpure exceptional graph is reduced by fourteen checked elementary simplicial collapses; closed-surface topology and orientation are checked independently. The partial prior coverage of the pure Klein-bottle type is explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive only for circulant graphs with 1 to 14 vertices. The known Q_{7,2} Klein-bottle triangulation already establishes the pure seven-regular case up to an explicit relabeling. No torsion absence or topology is asserted beyond 14 vertices; no all-graph minimality or global priority is claimed.
title: First integral torsion in circulant independence complexes: the fourteen-vertex threshold
